verses.original: Τοιγαροῦν ἡμεῖς καὶ ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν τοσοῦτον νέφος μαρτύρων ἀποθέμενοι πάντα ὄγκον καὶ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν εὐπερίστατον τρέχωμεν δι’ ὑπομονῆς τὸν ἀγῶνα προκείμενον ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Toigaroun hēmeis kai echontes perikeimenon hēmin tosouton nephos martyrōn apothemenoi panta onkon kai tēn hamartian euperistaton trechōmen di’ hypomonēs ton agōna prokeimenon hēmin
verses.literal: Therefore [since] we - are surrounded by . . . such a great cloud of witnesses let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin [that] so easily entangles [and] let us run with endurance the race set out for us

verses.original: ἀφορῶντες εἰς Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν τῆς πίστεως ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς χαρᾶς προκειμένης αὐτῷ ὑπέμεινεν σταυρὸν καταφρονήσας αἰσχύνης τε κεκάθικεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: aphorōntes eis Iēsoun ton archēgon kai teleiōtēn tēs pisteōs hos anti tēs charas prokeimenēs autō hypemeinen stauron kataphronēsas aischynēs te kekathiken en dexia tou thronou tou Theou
verses.literal: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus the author and perfecter of [our] faith who for the joy set before Him endured [the] cross scorning [its] shame and sat down at [the] right hand of the throne - of God

verses.original: γὰρ ἀναλογίσασθε τὸν ὑπομεμενηκότα τοιαύτην ἀντιλογίαν εἰς ἑαυτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἵνα μὴ κάμητε ἐκλυόμενοι ταῖς ὑμῶν ψυχαῖς
verses.transliteration: gar analogisasthe ton hypomemenēkota toiautēn antilogian eis heauton hypo tōn hamartōlōn hina mē kamēte eklyomenoi tais hymōn psychais
verses.literal: - Consider Him who endured such hostility . . . . . . from - sinners so that vvv you will not grow weary [and] lose heart . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: ἀνταγωνιζόμενοι πρὸς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν Οὔπω ἀντικατέστητε μέχρις αἵματος
verses.transliteration: antagōnizomenoi pros tēn hamartian Oupō antikatestēte mechris haimatos
verses.literal: In your struggle against - sin vvv you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood

verses.original: καὶ ἐκλέλησθε τῆς παρακλήσεως ἥτις διαλέγεται ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς μου Υἱέ μὴ ὀλιγώρει παιδείας Κυρίου μηδὲ ἐκλύου ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐλεγχόμενος
verses.transliteration: kai eklelēsthe tēs paraklēseōs hētis dialegetai hymin hōs huiois mou Huie mē oligōrei paideias Kyriou mēde eklyou hyp’ autou elenchomenos
verses.literal: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons My son {do} not take lightly [the] discipline of [the] Lord and [do not] lose heart - [when] He rebukes you

verses.original: γὰρ Κύριος παιδεύει ὃν ἀγαπᾷ δὲ μαστιγοῖ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται
verses.transliteration: gar Kyrios paideuei hon agapa de mastigoi panta huion hon paradechetai
verses.literal: For [the] Lord disciplines the one He loves and He chastises every son . . . He receives

verses.original: ὑπομένετε Εἰς παιδείαν ὁ Θεός προσφέρεται ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς γὰρ τίς υἱὸς ὃν οὐ παιδεύει πατήρ
verses.transliteration: hypomenete Eis paideian ho Theos prospheretai hymin hōs huiois gar tis huios hon ou paideuei patēr
verses.literal: Endure suffering as discipline - God is treating you as sons For what son - vvv is not disciplined [by his] father

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἐστε χωρίς παιδείας ἧς πάντες γεγόνασιν μέτοχοι ἄρα ἐστε νόθοι καὶ οὐχ υἱοί
verses.transliteration: de ei este chōris paideias hēs pantes gegonasin metochoi ara este nothoi kai ouch huioi
verses.literal: - If you do not experience . . . discipline like everyone vvv else then you are illegitimate children and not true sons

verses.original: εἶτα μὲν εἴχομεν ἡμῶν τῆς σαρκὸς τοὺς πατέρας παιδευτὰς καὶ ἐνετρεπόμεθα οὐ πολὺ δὲ μᾶλλον ὑποταγησόμεθα τῷ Πατρὶ τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ζήσομεν
verses.transliteration: eita men eichomen hēmōn tēs sarkos tous pateras paideutas kai enetrepometha ou poly de mallon hypotagēsometha tō Patri tōn pneumatōn kai zēsomen
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . we have all had vvv vvv earthly - fathers who disciplined [us] and we respected [them] {Should we} not much more . . . submit to the Father of [our] spirits and live

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπαίδευον πρὸς μὲν Οἱ ὀλίγας ἡμέρας κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῖς δοκοῦν δὲ ὁ ἐπὶ τὸ συμφέρον εἰς τὸ μεταλαβεῖν τῆς αὐτοῦ ἁγιότητος
verses.transliteration: gar epaideuon pros men Hoi oligas hēmeras kata to autois dokoun de ho epi to sympheron eis to metalabein tēs autou hagiotētos
verses.literal: - [Our fathers] disciplined [us] for vvv vvv a short time as - they thought best but [God disciplines us] for [our] good so that - we may share - in His holiness

verses.original: δὲ πᾶσα οὐ παιδεία δοκεῖ εἶναι χαρᾶς μὲν πρὸς τὸ παρὸν ἀλλὰ λύπης ὕστερον δὲ ἀποδίδωσιν καρπὸν δικαιοσύνης εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς γεγυμνασμένοις δι’ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: de pasa ou paideia dokei einai charas men pros to paron alla lypēs hysteron de apodidōsin karpon dikaiosynēs eirēnikon tois gegymnasmenois di’ autēs
verses.literal: - vvv No discipline seems vvv enjoyable - at the time but painful Later on however it yields a harvest of righteousness [and] peace to those who have been trained by it

verses.original: Διὸ ἀνορθώσατε τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας καὶ τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα
verses.transliteration: Dio anorthōsate tas pareimenas cheiras kai ta paralelymena gonata
verses.literal: Therefore strengthen [your] limp hands and - weak knees

verses.original: καὶ ποιεῖτε ὀρθὰς τροχιὰς τοῖς ὑμῶν ποσὶν ἵνα τὸ χωλὸν μὴ ἐκτραπῇ δὲ μᾶλλον ἰαθῇ
verses.transliteration: kai poieite orthas trochias tois hymōn posin hina to chōlon mē ektrapē de mallon iathē
verses.literal: - Make straight paths for your feet so that the lame {may} not be disabled but rather healed

verses.original: διώκετε Εἰρήνην μετὰ πάντων καὶ τὸν ἁγιασμόν χωρὶς οὗ οὐδεὶς ὄψεται τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: diōkete Eirēnēn meta pantōn kai ton hagiasmon chōris hou oudeis opsetai ton Kyrion
verses.literal: Pursue peace with everyone as well as - holiness without which no one will see the Lord

verses.original: ἐπισκοποῦντες μή τις ὑστερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ μή τις ῥίζα πικρίας φύουσα ἄνω ἐνοχλῇ καὶ δι’ αὐτῆς μιανθῶσιν οἱ πολλοί
verses.transliteration: episkopountes mē tis hysterōn apo tēs charitos tou Theou mē tis rhiza pikrias phyousa anō enochlē kai di’ autēs mianthōsin hoi polloi
verses.literal: See to it that no one falls short of the grace - of God [and] that no . . . root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and - - defile - many

verses.original: μή τις πόρνος ἢ βέβηλος ὡς Ἠσαῦ ὃς ἀντὶ μιᾶς βρώσεως ἀπέδετο ἑαυτοῦ τὰ πρωτοτόκια
verses.transliteration: mē tis pornos ē bebēlos hōs Ēsau hos anti mias brōseōs apedeto heautou ta prōtotokia
verses.literal: [See to it] that [no one is] sexually immoral or is godless like Esau who for a single meal sold his - birthright

verses.original: γὰρ ἴστε ὅτι καὶ μετέπειτα θέλων κληρονομῆσαι τὴν εὐλογίαν ἀπεδοκιμάσθη γὰρ εὗρεν οὐχ τόπον μετανοίας καίπερ ἐκζητήσας αὐτήν μετὰ δακρύων
verses.transliteration: gar iste hoti kai metepeita thelōn klēronomēsai tēn eulogian apedokimasthē gar heuren ouch topon metanoias kaiper ekzētēsas autēn meta dakryōn
verses.literal: For you know that - afterward when he wanted to inherit the blessing he was rejected vvv He could find no ground for repentance though he sought [the blessing] with tears

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ καὶ κεκαυμένῳ πυρὶ καὶ γνόφῳ καὶ ζόφῳ καὶ θυέλλῃ
verses.transliteration: gar Ou proselēlythate psēlaphōmenō kai kekaumenō pyri kai gnophō kai zophō kai thyellē
verses.literal: For vvv you have not come to [ a mountain that ] can be touched and [that] is burning with fire - to darkness - gloom and storm

verses.original: καὶ σάλπιγγος ἤχῳ καὶ φωνῇ ῥημάτων ἧς οἱ ἀκούσαντες παρῃτήσαντο μὴ λόγον προστεθῆναι αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai salpingos ēchō kai phōnē rhēmatōn hēs hoi akousantes parētēsanto mē logon prostethēnai autois
verses.literal: - to a trumpet blast [or] to a voice . . . that [made] [its] hearers beg that no further word be spoken -

verses.original: γὰρ οὐκ ἔφερον τὸ διαστελλόμενον Κἂν θηρίον θίγῃ τοῦ ὄρους λιθοβοληθήσεται
verses.transliteration: gar ouk epheron to diastellomenon Kan thērion thigē tou orous lithobolēthēsetai
verses.literal: For vvv they could not bear what was commanded If even an animal touches the mountain it must be stoned

verses.original: τὸ φανταζόμενον ἦν οὕτω φοβερὸν καί Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν εἰμι καὶ ἔντρομος Ἔκφοβός
verses.transliteration: to phantazomenon ēn houtō phoberon kai Mōusēs eipen eimi kai entromos Ekphobos
verses.literal: The sight was so terrifying [that] even Moses said I am - trembling with fear

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ προσεληλύθατε ὄρει Σιὼν καὶ πόλει ζῶντος Θεοῦ ἐπουρανίῳ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ μυριάσιν ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: Alla proselēlythate orei Siōn kai polei zōntos Theou epouraniō Ierousalēm kai myriasin angelōn
verses.literal: Instead you have come to Mount Zion - [to the] city of [the] living God [the] heavenly Jerusalem [You have come] to myriads of angels

verses.original: πανηγύρει καὶ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρωτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ Θεῷ Κριτῇ πάντων καὶ πνεύμασι δικαίων τετελειωμένων
verses.transliteration: panēgyrei kai ekklēsia prōtotokōn apogegrammenōn en ouranois kai Theō Kritē pantōn kai pneumasi dikaiōn teteleiōmenōn
verses.literal: in joyful assembly - [to the] congregation of [the] firstborn enrolled in heaven [You have come] to God [the] Judge of all - to [the] spirits of [the] righteous made perfect

verses.original: καὶ Ἰησοῦ μεσίτῃ νέας διαθήκης καὶ ῥαντισμοῦ αἵματι λαλοῦντι κρεῖττον παρὰ τὸν Ἅβελ
verses.transliteration: kai Iēsou mesitē neas diathēkēs kai rhantismou haimati lalounti kreitton para ton Habel
verses.literal: - to Jesus [the] mediator of a new covenant and to [the] sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than [the blood] of Abel

verses.original: Βλέπετε μὴ παραιτήσησθε τὸν λαλοῦντα γὰρ εἰ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἐξέφυγον παραιτησάμενοι τὸν χρηματίζοντα ἐπὶ γῆς πολὺ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς οἱ ἀποστρεφόμενοι τὸν ἀπ’ οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Blepete mē paraitēsēsthe ton lalounta gar ei ekeinoi ouk exephygon paraitēsamenoi ton chrēmatizonta epi gēs poly mallon hēmeis hoi apostrephomenoi ton ap’ ouranōn
verses.literal: See to it that vvv you do not refuse Him who speaks For if [the people] {did} not escape when they refused Him who warned [them] on earth how much less [will] we [escape] - if we reject Him who [warns us] from heaven

verses.original: τότε οὗ ἡ φωνὴ ἐσάλευσεν τὴν γῆν δὲ νῦν ἐπήγγελται λέγων Ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ
verses.transliteration: tote hou hē phōnē esaleusen tēn gēn de nyn epēngeltai legōn Eti hapax egō seisō ou monon tēn gēn alla ton ouranon kai
verses.literal: At that time [His] - voice shook the earth but now He has promised - vvv Once more I will shake not only the earth but - heaven as well

verses.original: δὲ τὸ Ἔτι ἅπαξ δηλοῖ τὴν μετάθεσιν τῶν σαλευομένων ὡς πεποιημένων ἵνα τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα μείνῃ
verses.transliteration: de to Eti hapax dēloi tēn metathesin tōn saleuomenōn hōs pepoiēmenōn hina ta mē saleuomena meinē
verses.literal: - The [words] vvv Once more signify the removal of what can be shaken that is created things so that the vvv unshakable may remain

verses.original: Διὸ παραλαμβάνοντες ἀσάλευτον βασιλείαν ἔχωμεν χάριν δι’ ἧς λατρεύωμεν τῷ Θεῷ εὐαρέστως μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δέους
verses.transliteration: Dio paralambanontes asaleuton basileian echōmen charin di’ hēs latreuōmen tō Theō euarestōs meta eulabeias kai deous
verses.literal: Therefore [since] we are receiving an unshakable kingdom let us be filled with gratitude [and so] . . . worship - God acceptably with reverence and awe

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἡμῶν ὁ Θεὸς καταναλίσκον πῦρ
verses.transliteration: kai gar hēmōn ho Theos katanaliskon pyr
verses.literal: - For our - God [is a] consuming fire
